MATERIALS SYNTHESIS DATASET

Synthesis records

Source-linked recipes, product structures and measured properties.

2,922Papers
1,222Material families
4,758Recipe–structure pairs

Each contributing primary paper counts once, irrespective of its number of recipes. Source locators, individual source scopes and missing information remain with the published records.

Material families are distinct directly synthesized material systems. Component-only pages point to the same records and add no families or pairs. The catalogue below contains published records with their individual source scopes.

Synthesis recipe–structure pairs

Each row links a recipe or supporting procedure to its product information. Source-reviewed recipe/sample rows retain their established count; additional source-linked records contribute one row each. Several measurements enrich the same row. Missing fields remain blank.

Information coverage. (a) 6 pairs have a more comprehensive description: source-backed quantified synthesis inputs, ordered operations with temperature and duration, sample-linked phase, morphology and dimensions, and a reference unit cell. (b) 4752 pairs have one or more of those categories not documented in the linked record. Each row lists its documentation gaps; this is not a claim that the original paper lacks the information. A reference cell is independently sourced and does not establish the measured atomic structure of the product. These categories do not imply a complete laboratory SOP.

The exact count is of documented recipe/sample pairs. Cross-paper physical-sample deduplication is not complete; these are not necessarily independent batches. Missing source details and conflicting statements remain visible in each record.

Explore synthesis and evidence records

Recipes, experimental series, supporting procedures and observations share one catalogue. Available product and structural fields are shown in each linked record.

Dataset downloads

Recipe–structure pairs ↓Product descriptors, recipe links and evidenceAll synthesis and evidence records ↓Canonical JSONL, including experimental seriesRecord schema ↓Quantities, sample identities and missing informationDataset manifest ↓Versions, sources and record identifiers
Provenance and reuse

Literature records are not independent laboratory reproductions. Supporting procedures and contextual observations remain linked to their sources. An illustrative morphology or a bulk reference cell does not become a measured product label. Machine-readable task eligibility is retained in the downloads.

The 100 selected PbS experimental rows are incorporated in this catalogue: 95 optical outcomes and five flagged failures. They come from Voznyy et al. (2019), official dataset, under CC BY-NC 4.0. Changes comprise named columns and units, row IDs, selected subset, derived cohort labels and null continuous targets for failure placeholders. Attribution and noncommercial restrictions accompany the exports. These rows do not supply particle structures. Article and figure rights remain separate.
